_comment: Copy this file to webapp_config.json (gitignored) or let the webapp create it on the first 'Save defaults' tap. All keys are optional — missing keys fall back to the defaults in src/webapp_config.py.
_comment_auth_token: Empty string = auth gate OFF (the default). Run scripts/gen_token.py to generate a strong token; the webapp will then require Authorization: Bearer <token> on every API call from non-loopback callers.
_comment_auth_password: Optional companion to auth_token: when set, a fresh device with no token shows a login overlay; entering the password swaps it for the bearer token. Set/clear via scripts/set_password.py. Failed attempts are logged to webapp/auth.log.
_comment_ocr_model_default: claude_opus read the 8-photo replay of #166 fastest (29 s, all photos). The gemini_* models run one call at a time on the hub and are much slower on long takes.
_comment_ocr_prompts: ocr_prompt_default picks one of the entries in config/ocr_prompts.json (committed). Add new entries there to expose more OCR styles in the webapp — no code change needed.
_comment_extract_chunk_size: Photos per hub request (a 'unit'). Units larger than one photo overlap by one photo. Python joins unit outputs in sequence order and removes duplicate lines at each seam; there is no second LLM stitch call.
_comment_extract_request_timeout_s: Seconds one hub request may take before it is abandoned and retried. Must be >= 10.
_comment_extract_run_budget_s: Wall-clock budget for a whole extraction, retries included. Photos still unread when it runs out are reported missing. Must be >= extract_request_timeout_s.
_comment_extract_concurrency: Hub requests in flight at once for one extraction (1-16). Backends the hub serializes (gemini) always run one at a time.
_comment_extract_fallback_model: Model a failed unit retries on once. Empty retries on the same model. Must be in ocr_models_available.
_comment_single_shot_max_photos: Cap on photos accepted by the synchronous single-shot POST /api/extract endpoint used by downstream fleet apps (see docs/consuming-the-session-api.md). A screenshot is 1-2 images; keep this small so a one-call consumer can't block on a large hub round-trip. Bigger takes use the async create -> photos -> extract -> poll session flow. Must be between 1 and max_photos_per_session.
_comment_search_enabled: Full-text search over the session archive (SQLite FTS5). true exposes a 🔎 search box on the History panel and builds archive/index.sqlite from extracted.txt on boot. false hides the UI and writes no index.
_comment_quality_gate_enabled: On-device pre-flight image quality gate. true makes the PWA score each added photo for blur/glare/exposure and show an advisory badge before Extract. false skips client-side scoring entirely.
